text: Robots just started clocking in... for real jobs.
Do you know what happens when a robot takes the shift next to you?
One robot company just built its one thousandth humanoid...
and it's already moving car parts in a BMW factory.
Another robot has moved over a hundred thousand boxes in a real warehouse.
And in China, one company sold nine hundred robots in six months...
and wants five thousand this year.
Now Tesla is building a factory line for a million robots a year.
Tesla's boss says one could cost around thirty thousand dollars.
First, the boring jobs go. Lifting. Sorting. Carrying boxes.
Then someone has to fix the robots, train them, and run them.
And that might be the next big job.
So be honest... would you work next to a robot?
